title: Transcriptomic profiling of chlorogenic acid and taurine treatment in human skin cells provides insights into cellular senescence mechanisms
comparison_or_design: The CGA-only RNA-seq comparison in normal human epidermal keratinocytes and its matched untreated reference.
time_scope: The 24-hour exposure in the reported skin-cell RNA-seq experiment.
excluded: GWAS, TWAS, CMap, network/pathway analyses and other skin-cell experiments
population_or_material: Normal human epidermal keratinocyte preparations in GSE302932.
requested_items: CGA alone versus untreated control, dose and exposure duration
